title: Western
story: Saddle up for dusty trails, wide skies and a little frontier fun.

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A cowboy hat with a wide curled brim and a tall creased crown with a band around it.
cards.hero_colors: tan brown hat with a red band

cards.name: Cowboy Boot
cards.subject: A leather cowboy boot with a tall shaft, a pointed toe, a slanted heel and a metal spur on the heel.
cards.hero_colors: brown leather with a silver spur

cards.name: Sheriff Star
cards.subject: A sheriff badge shaped like a five-pointed star with a small ball on each point and a pin on the back.
cards.hero_colors: gold star with silver ball tips

cards.name: Cactus
cards.subject: A tall green saguaro cactus with two upturned arms, planted in a clay pot, with a flower on top.
cards.hero_colors: green cactus in an orange clay pot with a pink flower

cards.name: Saloon Doors
cards.subject: A pair of swinging half-height saloon doors with slatted wooden panels and metal hinges in a wooden frame.
cards.hero_colors: warm brown wood with black hinges

cards.name: Horse
cards.subject: A brown horse standing sideways with a dark flowing mane, a long tail and four legs with light socks.
cards.hero_colors: chestnut brown with a white blaze on the face

cards.name: Barrel
cards.subject: A round wooden barrel with bulging sides, vertical planks and metal hoops around it.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown with blue metal hoops

cards.name: Covered Wagon
cards.subject: A covered wagon with a white arched canvas top, a wooden body and four spoked wooden wheels, and a pulling bar at the front.
cards.hero_colors: white canvas, brown wood, red wheel rims
cards.surface_or_setting: sandy desert trail with red rock hills

cards.name: Windmill
cards.subject: A tall wooden windmill tower with four legs, a round wheel of many metal blades and a tail fin.
cards.hero_colors: weathered brown wood and silver blades with a red tail fin

cards.name: Lasso Mix-up
cards.subject: The man in a cowboy hat swings a rope lasso and has accidentally caught the cow around her horns, who looks surprised.
cards.hero_colors: brown hat and mustache, white and black spotted cow, tan rope with a red knot

cards.name: Lasso
cards.subject: A coiled rope lasso with a big open loop and a knot where the loop slides.
cards.hero_colors: tan rope with a red knot

cards.name: Horseshoe
cards.subject: A U-shaped iron horseshoe with six nail holes along its curve.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey iron with copper nail holes

cards.name: Bandana
cards.subject: A triangular neckerchief tied in a knot with a pattern of dots.
cards.hero_colors: red cloth with white dots and a yellow knot

cards.name: Coffee Pot
cards.subject: A round enamel camp coffee pot with a curved spout, a side handle and a domed lid with a knob.
cards.hero_colors: speckled blue with a black handle and a yellow lid knob

cards.name: Saddle
cards.subject: A leather riding saddle with a raised horn at the front, a high back, two stirrups and a cinch strap.
cards.hero_colors: brown leather with silver stirrups

cards.name: Hay Bale
cards.subject: A rectangular bale of golden straw tied with two strings.
cards.hero_colors: golden yellow straw with red twine

cards.name: Wagon Wheel
cards.subject: A big wooden wagon wheel with twelve spokes, a center hub and an iron rim.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown with a black iron rim and a red hub

cards.name: Red Barn
cards.subject: A big barn with a sloped roof, a large double door with white X braces and a small hay window above.
cards.hero_colors: red barn with white trim and a grey roof
cards.surface_or_setting: green pasture with a wooden fence

cards.name: Campfire
cards.subject: A campfire with crossed logs, orange flames and a ring of grey stones around it.
cards.hero_colors: brown logs and orange flames with yellow tips on grey stones

cards.name: Rooster Rodeo
cards.subject: The rooster in a tiny cowboy hat crows on a hay bale while the sheep sits nearby wearing a red bandana.
cards.hero_colors: orange rooster, white fleece sheep, tan hat, red bandana

cards.name: Prickly Pear
cards.subject: A prickly pear cactus made of several flat oval green paddles with a few fruits on the edges.
cards.hero_colors: green paddles with pink fruits

cards.name: Tumbleweed
cards.subject: A round ball of tangled dry twigs with a few small leaves.
cards.hero_colors: light brown twigs with a few green leaves

cards.name: Spurs
cards.subject: A pair of spurs, each with a curved heel band, a short neck and a star-shaped spinning wheel, plus a leather strap.
cards.hero_colors: silver metal with brown leather straps and a red strap stitch

cards.name: Lantern
cards.subject: An old iron oil lantern with a glass globe, a flame inside, a top handle and a round base.
cards.hero_colors: black iron with a yellow flame and a red knob

cards.name: Gold Pan
cards.subject: A shallow round metal pan with sloped sides, holding a small heap of gold nuggets.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey pan with gold nuggets and a blue rim

cards.name: Mine Cart
cards.subject: An iron mine cart with a boxy body, four small wheels and a pushing handle, filled with gold nuggets.
cards.hero_colors: dark grey iron with gold nuggets and an orange stripe

cards.name: Roadrunner
cards.subject: A roadrunner bird with a head crest, a long beak, a long tail and two long legs, mid-stride.
cards.hero_colors: brown and cream streaked feathers with a blue patch by the eye

cards.name: Mine Entrance
cards.subject: A mine entrance with a wooden beam frame set into a rocky hillside and rail tracks leading inside.
cards.hero_colors: brown wooden beams on tan rock with grey rails and a red cart stop

cards.name: Steam Train
cards.subject: A steam locomotive with a round boiler, a tall funnel smokestack, a cowcatcher at the front, large wheels and a cab, on a track.
cards.hero_colors: black engine with a red cowcatcher and gold bell
cards.surface_or_setting: desert railway with red rock buttes

cards.name: Gold Find
cards.subject: The pig in a prospector hat holds up a giant gold nugget and grins while a pickaxe-free pan sits at its feet.
cards.hero_colors: pink pig, brown hat, shiny gold nugget
